scripts.build:statues: cd tools && node build-statues.mjs && cd .. && gltf-transform meshopt tools/statues.glb public/assets/statues.glb && gltf-transform simplify tools/statues.glb tools/statues-far.glb --ratio 0.2 --error 0.02 && gltf-transform meshopt tools/statues-far.glb public/assets/statues-far.glb && rm tools/statues.glb tools/statues-far.glb
scripts.build:villa: cd tools && node build-villa.mjs && cd .. && gltf-transform meshopt tools/villa.glb public/assets/villa.glb && rm tools/villa.glb
scripts.build:amphitheatre: cd tools && node build-amphitheatre.mjs && cd .. && gltf-transform meshopt tools/amphitheatre.glb public/assets/amphitheatre.glb && rm tools/amphitheatre.glb
scripts.build:kit: cd tools && node build-pompeii-kit.mjs && cd .. && gltf-transform meshopt tools/pompeii-kit.glb public/assets/pompeii-kit.glb && gltf-transform simplify tools/pompeii-kit.glb tools/pompeii-kit-far.glb --ratio 0.25 --error 0.004 && gltf-transform meshopt tools/pompeii-kit-far.glb public/assets/pompeii-kit-far.glb && rm tools/pompeii-kit.glb tools/pompeii-kit-far.glb
